system.notes:
Normal | Ranged

A guard bearing a longbow and quiver with fletched arrows.
Motives & Tactics: Arrest, make it through the day, pin down

Difficulty: 10 | Thresholds: 4/8 | HP: 3 | Stress: 2

ATK: +1 | Longbow: Far | 1d8+3 physical

Experience: Local Knowledge +3

Features

Hobbling Shot - Action: Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 1d12+3 physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they have Disadvantage on Finesse Rolls until they clear at least 1 HP.
